name: light_destroy_thermal_glow_pool
description: Light::DestroyThermalGlowPool walks the thermal-glow free list, deletes each light node, clears the list head, and returns one.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Light/zWeapon source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b21e0 validates walking g_OptCatalogThermalGlowFreeList through callbackContext at offset 0x40, clearing each node's callbackContext, calling zClass_Class::DeleteNodeByType, clearing the global head, and returning one.
The native thermal-glow smoke initializes the pool, validates the free-list shape, calls DestroyThermalGlowPool, and verifies the free list is cleared and the active-node count returns to zero.
